title: Chrome Dino Game
description:
Pixel dinosaur runner for BMW iDrive 7/8.
Four difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard, Extreme.
Dashboard only; difficulty and language on the right, GPU animation and multilingual menus.
BMW language detection. Play only while parked.
